checks.note: OAuth2 page confirms third-party access to Marketing API on behalf of other users, self-service registration. Quick-start confirms API key as Basic auth password with any username. API keys page confirms expiry for keys created on/after 2026-06-22.

Manager role can create keys (page says Manager, Admin can view others' keys); no plan requirement stated anywhere fetched, so Free-plan access is unverified. OAuth approval step not mentioned (inferred). Note: key scope depends on creator's role, not strictly 'full account access'.
REST, JSON, root https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/, OpenAPI schema published. Breadth 'broad' is plausible but not explicitly stated on the page.

Mailchimp publishes an official MCP server page, but it is docs-search only (https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server, no credential, cannot act on an account). So 'none found officially' was wrong; an official one exists, though it is not an account-action toolkit. The PyPI package is community (damientilman), not vendor.

ready_with_caveats is consistent: REST+OAuth2/API key work, with unverified plan tier and rate limits. Blocker text should be updated to reflect the official docs-only MCP and the role-scoped key wording.

corrected.one_liner: Email and marketing automation platform for managing audiences, campaigns, automations and reporting.
corrected.auth_notes: API key sent as HTTP Basic auth password (any string as username). OAuth2 authorization-code flow for third-party apps accessing the Marketing API on behalf of other users (login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/authorize and /token); apps registered via the self-service Registered Apps page. API key access depends on the role of the creating user; keys created on/after 2026-06-22 expire one year after creation.
corrected.access_notes: Users with Manager role or higher can generate an API key in their account; OAuth app registration needs only a Mailchimp account. No vendor page fetched states which plan tiers include API access, so whether a Free plan works is not verified. The OAuth page does not mention an approval step (inferred self-serve). Rate limits not verified.
corrected.blocker: Plan-tier requirement for API access and rate limits not confirmed from vendor pages. Mailchimp's official MCP server (https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server) is documentation search only and cannot act on an account; account actions need the REST API directly or a community MCP (e.g. mailchimp-mcp on PyPI, which uses an API key). API keys now expire yearly, so OAuth2 is preferable for a multi-user toolkit. A hosted account endpoint (ai-inc.mailchimp.com/claude/mcp/v2) appears only in a third-party listing and is unconfirmed.
